skill.name: email-sequence
skill.description: Create and optimize email sequences, drip campaigns, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows, re-engagement campaigns, and nurture programs for marketing teams.
skill.summary: Designs lifecycle email sequences with triggers, timing, copy, CTAs, segmentation, and measurement plans.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Lifecycle emails are hard to plan across triggers, timing, copy, and metrics. This skill turns campaign goals into structured sequences with emails, CTAs, segments, and testing plans.
actual_capabilities: Designs welcome, nurture, onboarding, re-engagement, win-back, billing, and campaign sequences.
Defines triggers, goals, timing, exit conditions, segments, and email order.
Drafts subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTAs, and conditions for each email.
Builds audit checklists across onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign emails.
Suggests personalization, segmentation, A/B tests, and metrics for optimization.
limitations: Does not connect to email service providers or send messages.
Does not verify legal compliance for CAN-SPAM, GDPR, or industry rules.
Needs audience, offer, brand voice, and performance data for best results.
Cannot guarantee open rates, clicks, or revenue outcomes.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Onboarding
use_cases.description: Create a welcome flow that guides new users to activation, helpful resources, and the next product milestone.

use_cases.title: Convert Trials to Paid
use_cases.description: Plan a trial sequence that reinforces value, handles objections, and prompts upgrades before the trial ends.

use_cases.title: Recover Inactive Contacts
use_cases.description: Build re-engagement emails that remind subscribers of value, offer a clear choice, and protect list quality.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Welcome Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new list or product signup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5-email welcome sequence for [product] after someone signs up. Include timing, subject lines, preview text, body copy, and one CTA per email.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Trial Conversion Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for SaaS trial users.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a trial-to-paid email sequence for [audience]. The trial lasts [length]. Include triggers, send timing, objections to address, and upgrade CTAs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving current emails.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this email sequence for clarity, relevance, CTA focus, timing, segmentation, and measurement. Suggest prioritized improvements and rewrite weak emails.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Lifecycle Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a lifecycle email program for [business]. Include onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, campaign emails, segmentation rules, exit conditions, and metrics.

output_examples.input: Create a welcome sequence for a project management app.
output_examples.output: A five-email sequence with an immediate welcome, quick win, origin story, social proof, and objection-handling email. Each email includes timing, subject, preview text, body copy, and CTA.

output_examples.input: Improve our trial conversion emails for small business owners.
output_examples.output: A trial flow that summarizes user progress, highlights missing premium value, uses relevant proof, adds urgency near trial end, and tracks upgrade conversion.
A checklist covering onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign emails, with gaps ranked by customer impact and implementation effort.

best_practices: Provide the audience, trigger, offer, product stage, and current email performance.
Choose one primary CTA and one success metric before drafting copy.
Review legal, brand, and deliverability requirements before sending any sequence.
anti_patterns: Requesting a long sequence without a conversion goal or audience context.
Using one generic email flow for every segment and lifecycle stage.
Treating draft copy as ready to send without compliance and deliverability review.

faq.question: What can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create email sequences for welcome, nurture, onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign workflows.

faq.question: Can it write full email copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft subjects, preview text, body copy, CTAs, and sequence notes for each email.

faq.question: Does it send emails?
faq.answer: No. It creates strategy and copy, but it does not connect to email platforms or send messages.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, trigger, goal, offer, brand voice, sequence length, and any current performance data.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing sequence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can audit timing, relevance, CTA focus, segmentation, copy quality, and metrics.

faq.question: Does it handle compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It can remind you to review compliance, but legal and deliverability checks remain your responsibility.
